title_original: The Photo Review : Annual Benefit Auction

blocks.text: The Photo Review , a critical journal of photography founded in 1976, will celebrate its 50th anniversary with a spectacular Annual Benefit Auction on Saturday, October 24, 2026, at 4 p.m. at the Moore College of Art & Design, 1916 Race Street, Philadelphia, PA 19103. The auction will offer a significant array of photographs from the 19th century to the present. Buyers can preview the live auction online at https://photoreview.org/events/2026-benefit-auction/ .

Absentee bids can be received by 6 p.m. EST on October 23, 2026, by emailing [email protected] or calling 215/891-0214. The Photo Review will offer its END THIS AUCTION feature. Bid the high estimate on any unsold lot and your bid will be considered the winning bid and the work will be withdrawn from the auction.
You can also register and bid on LiveAuctioneers: https://www.liveauctioneers.com/catalog/435082_the-2026-photo-review-benefit-auction/.
A preview will be held at Moore on Friday, October 23, 12–5 PM, and Saturday, October 24, 12 – 3 PM with a reception from 3–4 PM on Saturday.
